verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly implies bulk capability: contacts and activity data can be imported or synced in bulk, the API returns up to 200 events per page with cursor pagination for bulk reads, and the APIs and MCP server let agents read and write data headlessly. No documented bulk create, update or delete endpoint or batch-job API is shown. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch write endpoints (e.g. bulk profile import or subscribe jobs), bulk operations exposed via the MCP server for agents, documented batch size limits and job status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
